description: This file defines the 'Framework' class which extends Symfony's HttpKernel to handle HTTP requests within the OrangeHRM application. It initializes and configures core components such as the dependency injection container, logger, router, and plugins, and provides mechanisms for request handling and application setup.

classes.name: Framework
classes.description: The core class extending Symfony's HttpKernel, responsible for configuring and managing the application's service container, logging, routing, plugin initialization, and request handling.

methods.name: configureContainer
methods.description: Initializes dependency injection container with core services like request stack, router, event dispatcher, controller resolver, argument resolver, doctrine, and authentication provider chain.

methods.name: configureLogger
methods.description: Sets up the logging system and subscribes a logger subscriber to the event dispatcher.

methods.name: configureRouter
methods.description: Configures the routing system, including route matching, URL generation, and request event listeners.

methods.name: configurePlugins
methods.description: Loads and initializes plugins based on configuration.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests, configuring routing and plugins before delegating to the parent handle method.

methods.name: isDebug
methods.description: Returns whether debug mode is enabled.
